title: Sai
capsule: Sai (塞) was one of the 'Three Qins' that Xiang Yu carved from the conquered Qin heartland of Guanzhong in 206 BCE, granted to the surrendered Qin general Sima Xin with its capital at Yueyang, northeast of modern Xi'an in the eastern Guanzhong plain. Installed alongside Zhang Han's Yong and Dong Yi's Zhai to hem in Liu Bang, Sima Xin's kingdom instead fell when Han forces burst out of Hanzhong in their surprise invasion of Guanzhong in 206–205 BCE. Sai's separate existence therefore lasted barely a year before its absorption into the expanding Han state.
attestation: Boundaries from Seshat Cliopatria (Bennett et al., Scientific Data 2025; CC BY 4.0), digitized from standard historical atlases at ~0.07° resolution.
